decisions.reason: F8 is valid under def-derivative, Definition, “Differentiability on a set”: differentiable means at every point of the domain, including interval endpoints. Such differentiability implies continuity on I (cor-differentiable-implies-continuous), so cor-zero-derivative-implies-constant applies. The proposed f on [0,1] is not differentiable at 1: its quotient is -1/(x-1), unbounded as x tends to 1 from below. Step 4.1 uses differences of C2 model position curves and the smooth explicit solution on a common interval containing the initial event; these are continuous, have zero derivative and zero initial value. Hence componentwise uniqueness is sound.
